rachel: Heads-up: our nightly SAST started spitting lots of findings after an RBAC change that removed decrypt rights from the keystore SA. scanners treat missing fixtures as code issues. anyone touch KMS bindings? :grimacing:

ben: that was me (PR#5342). I removed a broad decrypt binding to follow least-priv. didn't realize the CI runners used that SA. I can revert immediately.

kai: sample error from the scanner: 
`Permission \u0027cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt\u0027 denied for serviceAccount:ci-keystore@redwood-prod`

rachel: can someone confirm whether KMS logged DENIED entries or if requests never made it? run: `gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\\\"serviceAccount:ci-keystore@redwood-prod\\\" AND protoPayload.methodName:kms.*Decrypt\" --limit=20 --format=json`

oncall-sre: applying revert now (terraform infra-prod). ETA ~2m.

oncall-sre: revert applied. audit logs show DENIED entries at 03:02 then SUCCESS after revert. new SAST run decrypted fixtures and noise dropped.

sec-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-ALT. Owner assigned: ben. Evidence retention set to 14d. Label infra:keystore-outage applied to affected runs.

kai: follow-ups: - add pre-merge checklist item for any change touching cloudkms: run infra-smoke/kms-decrypt + include log-query output in PR description; - prefer key-scoped bindings or SA impersonation rather than project-wide grants; - require TTL annotation on temporary regrants.

ben: I'll open PR#5343 to reapply a scoped grant with TTL and an impact statement, and link SEC-2026-ALT.

rachel: SecOps: please mark the SAST findings from the affected runs as infra:ignored for 14d so triage doesn't spend cycles. oncall-sre: file an infra ticket to add the preflight smoke job.

oncall-sre: filed INFRA-210 to add infra-smoke/kms-decrypt triggered on terraform diffs touching cloudkms resources.
